authority: Research only; A2 (finite-precision operational approximation) only. No native implementation, map/access/premise adoption, A1 statement, total-randomness bound or OI equivalence.
comparison: Complete public record of the alternating a/X read protocol from X+, source versus quantum projective instrument, for (i) every controller with finite persistent state, a time-independent update and one fresh block of B fair bits per slot, and (ii) the a2_depth_v7 retained-seed reset restarted every k reads, RS(B,k).
engine: Self-contained standard-library exact integer/rational engine; imports no prior checker; rebuilds the executed grid and checks it against the retained a2 count digest; reads a2_depth_v7/result.json after checking its pinned SHA-256 and uses its values only as reproduction targets.

credited, as in a2_depth_v7, for the separation of infinite products of nonidentical laws

plan_commit_note: committed at 1dfec979 (2026-10-25 03:52:56 UTC), a single-parent child of #911's head 49e1a119, touching PLAN.md alone. The repository establishes that PLAN.md was committed alone before any other file of this package and that the execution code was first committed after it. Correction: PLAN.md's sentence that it was committed "alone before any computation of this round" is inaccurate. By the author's account (no artifact of the exploration is retained; the repository cannot corroborate it), the author reports that one floating-point exploration ran before the plan, of a floor-truncated rescaling decoder with a fixed-width m-bit register (B=1..4, m=0..8), a finite-state member of the bounded-state class, not of the RS family; qualitatively it showed several closed classes and absorbing states, stationary agreement defects that did not shrink steadily with m, and at B=2, m=4 a class matching frequency 4/5 to float precision while differing in run masses at n>=2; it steered the choice of tested family to RS(B,k); and it did not compute on RS(B,k), on the census populations or on the decision rule. It may have informed K5, the run-mass proof route, the census populations, the small-n mismatch expectation and the choice to compute exact stationary laws; that influence cannot be measured after the fact, and the order in which the proof route and the exploration arose cannot be established. The decoder is recomputed exactly, post-review, as the second concrete class member.
